messages:
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Initiating percent rollout: r2026.03.24 -> stage: canary-global, from 5% -> target 25%. change_window ends in 22m. Monitoring: 99p latency, error-rate, route-availability.

marco: bump started. first wave stable so far but watching eu-west.

sasha: seeing a small 502 uptick for /chat streaming on edge-nodes in eu-west (3.1% -> 6.4%). sample trace below.

```
[2026-03-24T10:05:12Z] request_id=abc123 node=eu-w-03 upstream_error=502 gateway="upstream read timeout" backend="model-serving-v2"
```

emma: thanks sasha. are these user-facing errors or internal retries? metrics show an increase in client retries but not raw 5xx in the LB.

os-ryan: ops-ryan: rolling logs show transient TLS handshake failures to the model pool on eu-w-03 around 10:05. could be a cert rotation overlap. I've escalated to infra-cert team.

product-julia: change window is still open but if this is regional it's safer to pin region rather than full rollback. customers in eu rely on low-latency.

marco: propose this flow: (1) freeze percent ramp at current 7% (don't progress to 25%), (2) pin eu routing to previous version r2026.03.23, (3) keep other regions progressing to 25% but monitor closely. opinions?

emma: +1 to freeze. prefer pin rather than full rollback so we limit blast radius.

sasha: agree, but we need to ensure the routing rule change propagates within 2m or we risk more user errors. @deploy-bot can you apply pin for eu-west and freeze global ramp?

deploy-bot: Action: freeze global_percent_ramp -> 7%. Applying regional pin: eu-west -> r2026.03.23. Executed by marco. Job id jb-90102.

ops-ryan: pin applied. Verified traffic for eu-west now served by r2026.03.23. No disruption.

emma: I'm going to open a quick canary-debug session on the stuck nodes and run `curl` against the health endpoint to capture handshake traces.

marco: product-julia please update release notes and the customer-facing status note: mark rollout delayed for eu until cert rotation confirmed. add internal rollback decision criteria.

product-julia: will do. Drafting now and pinging PMs.

sasha: infra-cert team responded: cert rotation started at 09:59 but one worker missed the new cert deployment -> causing intermittent handshake errors. They are redeploying on eu-w-03. ETA 10m.

emma: re-running short smoke: health OK on eu-w-03 post-redeploy. observed 502 rate back down to 1.2%.

marco: great. can we unpin eu-west and resume ramp to 25% or do we need a cooldown?

os-ryan: ops-ryan: I'd prefer a phased resume: lift eu pin to 10% for 15m, observe 5m steady-state, then lift to 25% if metrics are green. less risky.

product-julia: change window closes in 12m; if we can't finish the phased resume before close, we should postpone the final bump to next window and notify stakeholders.

marco: agreed. schedule: unpin -> target 10% now, monitor 15m, then decision. @deploy-bot please set eu-west target_percent=10 and create a monitor alert for 502 > 2.5%.

deploy-bot: Setting eu-west target_percent=10, monitor threshold 502>2.5% configured. Job id jb-90103.

emma: smoke looks stable so far. keeping an eye on latency tail.

sasha: i'll keep the tracing session open. if 502 crosses threshold we rollback fully.

product-julia: updating release notes: "Canary rollout paused for EU while infra cert rotation validated. Regional pin to previous version applied; incremental resume planned. Customers: expect normal service." publishing internal changelog.

marco: summary: STOP -> freeze global ramp (done). PIN -> eu-west pinned (done). PARTIAL RESUME -> eu-west to 10% (done). Decision window: 15m observation then proceed or defer. reopening thread for any regressions. :heavy_check_mark:
